info.title: Important information:
info.item1: The environment is configured for HOMOLOGATION (testing). Invoices will have no fiscal value.
info.item2: Obtain the CSC and CSC ID from your state's SEFAZ portal.
info.item3: After saving, click "Register Company" to sync with Nuvem Fiscal.
info.item4: NFC-e issuance will be automatically available after registration and activation.
